n360198399d.headline: AIIB picks Uzbekistan as its leading regional investment spot - Konstantin Limitovskiy (Exclusive interview)
n360198399d.summary: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank has approved projects for Uzbekistan worth over $3 billion, making its investment portfolio the largest in Central Asia. The article is an exclusive interview.
n360198399d.why: The AIIB is a multilateral development bank that finances infrastructure across Asia, and its lending shapes construction and investment pipelines in member countries.

n214c1c9799.headline: Kusumgar Files Draft Papers With SEBI For ₹650-Crore IPO
n214c1c9799.summary: Engineered fabric maker Kusumgar has filed draft papers with India's Sebi to raise Rs 650 crore through an IPO. The offering is entirely an offer-for-sale by promoters.
n214c1c9799.why: An IPO filed with India's market regulator Sebi is the first formal step toward a public listing on Indian exchanges.

ne6f6773e67.headline: Reeves says ‘world has changed’ since last year as she hints at tax rises
ne6f6773e67.summary: UK Chancellor Rachel Reeves said the world has changed since last year and hinted at tax rises. She had promised business leaders in 2024 there would be no more taxes.
ne6f6773e67.why: The Chancellor of the Exchequer sets UK fiscal policy, and tax changes affect government borrowing, gilt yields and corporate profitability.

n8e10358a04.headline: Deadline Nears for Capital One Lawsuit Cash
n8e10358a04.summary: Eligible Capital One 360 Savings account holders must file claims by Oct. 2 to receive part of a $425M settlement.
n8e10358a04.why: Capital One is a major US bank holding company, and litigation settlements affect its legal costs and reputation.

nff8725b7d7.headline: FCMB converts N23bn loan to shares, lists 3.16bn units on NGX
nff8725b7d7.summary: The Nigerian Exchange announced the listing of 3.16 billion additional FCMB Group shares at 50 kobo each, following the conversion of a N23bn loan into equity.
nff8725b7d7.why: FCMB Group is a Nigerian holding company for a commercial bank, and debt-to-equity conversions change its capital structure and share count.

n74fd559e77.headline: Home purchase mortgage approvals dip as buyers ‘pause for reflection’
n74fd559e77.summary: Mortgage approvals at the upper end of the UK housing market fell as buyers paused for reflection ahead of the autumn Budget, according to some housing market experts.
n74fd559e77.why: Mortgage approvals are a leading indicator of housing activity and reflect borrowing conditions that affect banks and the broader economy.

source.name: East London and West Essex Guardian Series

sources.name: East London and West Essex Guardian Series

n6ef1e874fd.headline: Opec+ plans oil output hike in November
n6ef1e874fd.summary: Opec+ plans to increase oil output in November. Prices have mostly traded between $60 and $70 per barrel since production increases began in April, after starting the year above $80.
n6ef1e874fd.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil-producing countries that coordinates output levels, and its production decisions directly influence global crude supply and prices.
n6ef1e874fd.why_moved: Planned output increases by OPEC+ add supply to the market, and oil has been trading in a $60-$70 range since production increases began.

ne5fbaa09dc.headline: PrivatBank to launch program for financing purchase of agricultural land
ne5fbaa09dc.summary: State-owned PrivatBank plans to launch a program financing purchases of agricultural land by the end of 2025. The plan was described by corporate business department head Yevhen Kulikov at the Forbes Agro 2025 forum.
ne5fbaa09dc.why: PrivatBank is Ukraine's largest state-owned lender, and farmland financing supports the country's agricultural sector, a major export earner. New lending programs shape credit availability for agribusiness.

n768208a5b0.headline: Nativo Resources interim loss widens, finance costs doubles
n768208a5b0.summary: Nativo Resources said its half-year loss widened as it pursued gold mining and processing projects in Peru, including the acquisition of the Morrocota mine.
n768208a5b0.why: Nativo Resources is a junior mining company whose results and funding costs reflect the capital needs of early-stage gold developers.

nd7781bf873.headline: Home purchase mortgage approvals dip as buyers ‘pause for reflection’
nd7781bf873.summary: Demand at the upper end of the UK housing market was affected ahead of the autumn Budget, with home purchase mortgage approvals dipping, some housing market experts said.
nd7781bf873.why: Mortgage approvals are a leading indicator of housing activity, which feeds into consumer spending, construction and the Bank of England's rate outlook.

na6e39697dc.headline: Asian shares close mostly higher, US dollar dips
na6e39697dc.summary: Asian shares closed mostly higher and the US dollar dipped, though Japan's Nikkei index closed lower despite Wall Street breaking its three-day losing streak.
na6e39697dc.why: Asian equity closes and currency moves reflect investor reaction to US markets and shifts in global risk appetite.

n6fcec233a0.headline: Energy Committee insists on revenue recovery before any power price adjustment
n6fcec233a0.summary: The chairman of Parliament's Select Committee on Energy said the House will not approve any electricity tariff increase until power agencies show significant gains in revenue collection and efficiency.
n6fcec233a0.why: Electricity tariffs set the price utilities can charge, which determines the revenue and financial health of Ghana's power sector.

n33adc86455.headline: Dar Global to launch Saudi Arabia project with Trump Organisation
n33adc86455.summary: Dar Global said its planned Saudi Arabia project is its second collaboration with The Trump Organisation in Jeddah. The deal marks an extension of the partnership.
n33adc86455.why: Dar Global is a real estate developer, and partnerships with branded developers shape its project pipeline in Gulf markets.

n8257341ec9.headline: Nigeria: SEC raises alarm over AI-generated investment scams
n8257341ec9.summary: Nigeria's Securities and Exchange Commission has warned investors about a rising wave of AI-driven scams. The scams target Nigerians with fraudulent investment schemes.
n8257341ec9.why: The SEC regulates Nigeria's capital markets and protects investors from fraud.

nd0ea55b315.headline: FactCheck: value of UK arms imported by Israel ‘reached record high in June’
nd0ea55b315.summary: Channel 4 News analysis of Israel Tax Authority data finds the value of UK arms imported by Israel reached a record high in June. The analysis covers 8 million rows of data.
nd0ea55b315.why: Arms trade flows are governed by export licensing and are a politically sensitive area of international trade.

n95a1559b5b.headline: Claire's Accessories reach deal to secure 1,000 jobs across UK
n95a1559b5b.summary: Claire's Accessories has agreed to the sale of 156 shops across the UK, a deal described as saving hundreds of jobs. The description cites about 1,000 jobs secured.
n95a1559b5b.why: Claire's is a UK-focused accessories retailer, and store sales and restructuring shape retail employment and landlord exposure.

na2fc38c8f9.headline: Equity market sustains growth trajectory amid profit-taking activities
na2fc38c8f9.summary: The Nigerian equities market sustained its upward momentum, with bullish sentiment dominating trading despite profit-taking. The report also cites a mixed reaction to an unspecified development.
na2fc38c8f9.why: The Nigerian Exchange in Lagos is the country's main equity market, and its index tracks broad investor sentiment in Africa's largest economies.

na074fed74b.headline: Sysco buys UK foodservice supplier Fairfax Meadow from Hilton Food Group
na074fed74b.summary: US foodservice distributor Sysco has bought Fairfax Meadow from Hilton Food Group, following its purchase of Scottish supplier Campbell's Prime Meat last October.
na074fed74b.why: Sysco is a major US food distributor to restaurants and institutions, and acquisitions expand its supply chain and product range.

n69a53ce4ba.headline: India Engaged In Trade Talks With US, EU, New Zealand, Oman, Peru, Chile: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal
n69a53ce4ba.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is in talks on free trade agreements with several partners, while Qatar and Bahrain have also expressed interest.
n69a53ce4ba.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and shape export access, which matters for investors in Indian exporters and trade-exposed sectors.

n8e750ad548.headline: PENGASSAN-Dangote disputes may disrupt national grid stability - NISO
n8e750ad548.summary: Nigeria's independent system operator NISO has expressed concern that the ongoing dispute between PENGASSAN and Dangote could disrupt national grid stability.
n8e750ad548.why: Dangote is a large Nigerian refiner and petrochemical group, and labour disputes at its facilities can affect fuel supply and power-sector stability.

n07f73f6063.headline: JUST-IN: Court Restrains PENGASSAN, Others From Cutting Gas Supply To Dangote Refinery
n07f73f6063.summary: The National Industrial Court in Abuja has stopped the Petroleum and Natural Gas Workers Association of Nigeria and others from cutting gas supply to the Dangote refinery. The order follows a legal challenge to the planned cut.
n07f73f6063.why: The Dangote refinery is one of Africa's largest single-site refineries, and gas supply disruptions would affect its fuel output and Nigeria's petroleum supply.

n000a43ea8a.headline: Nigeria gains global recognition for Tax-ID, FIRS named-Peppol authority
n000a43ea8a.summary: Nigeria has secured global registration of its Tax Identification Number and the Federal Inland Revenue Service has been named a Peppol authority. The milestone is part of its digital trade transformation.
n000a43ea8a.why: Peppol is a global standard for electronic procurement and invoicing that eases cross-border trade. Digital tax systems can improve revenue collection and business compliance.

n546add63eb.headline: Democrats and Republicans face 'large differences' ahead of shutdown deadline
n546add63eb.summary: After a bipartisan meeting with President Trump, lawmakers face a September 30 deadline to avoid a US government shutdown, with large differences remaining.
n546add63eb.why: A federal government shutdown halts some public services and delays economic data releases, creating uncertainty for markets.

nebe80a2dad.headline: ‘OBR needs to change way it forecasts economic performance’, Reeves says
nebe80a2dad.summary: The Chancellor told broadcasters only one full forecast should be done a year, as the government aims to change fiscal policy only once annually.
nebe80a2dad.why: The Office for Budget Responsibility produces the forecasts that underpin UK fiscal policy and government borrowing projections.

ne6d5e13411.headline: KSE-100 hits all-time high as debt deal, global ties fuel rally
ne6d5e13411.summary: Pakistan's KSE-100 index rose beyond 163,000 for the first time on Monday, as optimism over stabilising fundamentals and deepening ties supported investors.
ne6d5e13411.why: The KSE-100 is Pakistan's main stock benchmark, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
ne6d5e13411.why_moved: Investors reacted to optimism over a debt deal, stabilising fundamentals and deepening global ties.

n8adfae0884.headline: BP Just Approved A $5 Billion Oil Project
n8adfae0884.summary: BP approved a $5 billion oil and gas project in the Gulf of America, expected to begin production in 2030 with capacity of 80,000 barrels of crude per day.
n8adfae0884.why: BP is a major integrated oil company, and its upstream project approvals shape future oil supply and growth.

n85974c0c20.headline: Indonesia prepares rules to curb illegal cigarettes
n85974c0c20.summary: The Indonesian government plans to issue a new regulation to curb the circulation of illegal cigarettes, particularly those sold without excise bands.
n85974c0c20.why: Excise revenue on tobacco is an important source of government income, and illegal sales erode legal producers' market share and tax receipts.

n007053da4f.headline: Budget geared to meet 13MP goals
n007053da4f.summary: Budget 2026 will be the first annual government spending plan to meet goals set out in the 13th Malaysia Plan, the country's five-year development blueprint, according to The Star.
n007053da4f.why: Government budgets set public spending and fiscal deficit targets that influence growth, bond issuance and sovereign credit assessments.

n73340b6455.headline: Global debt rises to record $337.7trn in H1 2025
n73340b6455.summary: Global debt climbed to a record $337.7 trillion by the end of the second quarter of 2025. The rise was fuelled by looser global financial conditions and a weaker U.S. dollar.
n73340b6455.why: Global debt tracking, compiled by the Institute of International Finance in Washington, gauges leverage across governments, companies and households. Record levels matter for borrowing costs, credit risk and financial stability.

nb991e7eb33.headline: Netherland to commit €2 bn to Tata Steel decarbonisation project
nb991e7eb33.summary: The Dutch government has agreed to provide €2 billion in support for the decarbonisation project of Tata Steel Netherlands. The funding targets the company's emissions reduction plans.
nb991e7eb33.why: Tata Steel is an Indian-owned steelmaker with major operations in the Netherlands. Steel decarbonisation requires large capital investment, and state support can determine project timing and feasibility.

impacts.name: Tata Steel Netherlands
impacts.why: State funding of €2 billion directly supports the company's decarbonisation project.
